name: antares-vscode
description: Run the Antares CWE vulnerability-localization agent from VS Code against any OpenAI-compatible or Ollama endpoint.

enumDescriptions: Ollama server exposing the OpenAI-compatible API (chat completions). Defaults to http://localhost:11434/v1.

antares.provider.markdownDescription: Connection preset. Selects sensible defaults for the API style and endpoint. Override individual fields below as needed.

antares.endpoint.markdownDescription: Inference endpoint base URL (e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1`). Leave empty to use the provider default (Ollama only).

antares.model.markdownDescription: Served model ID. Must match the identifier exposed by your endpoint exactly (e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:7b`, `antares-1b`).

antares.apiStyle.markdownDescription: Which OpenAI-compatible API to call. `auto` derives it from the provider (chat for Ollama/OpenAI-compatible, completions for vLLM). `chat` targets `/v1/chat/completions`; `completions` targets `/v1/completions`.

antares.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Python 3.11+ interpreter. Leave empty to auto-detect. If the interpreter already has `antares-cli` installed it is used directly; otherwise a managed virtual environment is created.

antares.autoInstall.markdownDescription: Automatically create a managed virtual environment and install `antares-cli` when it is not already available.

antares.packageSpec.markdownDescription: pip requirement used to install Antares into the managed environment. Can be a version (`antares-cli==1.2.3`), a local path, or a wheel file.

antares.toolBudget.markdownDescription: Repository tool-call budget per scan. `0` uses the Antares default.

antares.sweep.workers.markdownDescription: Number of parallel CWE workers used by Auto-Sweep.

antares.sweep.maxCwes.markdownDescription: Maximum number of CWE classes Auto-Sweep will select automatically.

antares.diagnosticsSeverity.markdownDescription: Severity used for findings reported in the Problems panel.
